evidenceBasedConclusions.conclusion: The most defensible current assessment is based on “EU age-verification blueprint is technically ready and supports national eIDs, passports and identity cards,” the strongest indexed record by source grade and evidence status.
evidenceBasedConclusions.evidence: The Commission says its age-verification solution became feature-ready in April 2026. Proof of age can be issued from national eIDs, passports, identity cards, banking apps or offline activation, while the design aims to disclose only the required age threshold.
evidenceBasedConclusions.limitations: One strong record cannot by itself prove a wider pattern, motive, conspiracy or command structure.
evidenceBasedConclusions.alternativeInterpretation: The record may have a narrower legal or factual meaning than the surrounding public narrative suggests.
